lesson_title: The Accounting Cycle: Six Stages, One Machine
hook_text: Every rand in a business travels the exact same route. Here it is.
clip_script: Now let us verify our understanding by running the whole June story through the cycle in one breath. A cash sale happens: the till slip is the source document. The slip's amount is entered in the CRJ. At month end the CRJ totals are posted to Bank and Sales in the ledger. The ledger balances are listed in the trial balance, which must balance. At year end, Sales flows into the Trading account and profit is determined in the final accounts. Finally, that profit appears in the financial statements the owner reads.
visual_style: Animated flow diagram building stage by stage, one till slip travelling along a conveyor through six labelled stations.
pacing: Steady build, one beat per stage, quick recap at the end.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to master all six stages.
